changes.title: Followers ground
items: Animals following you weigh you down: an adult's worth (one adult, or three young; lighter and heavier kinds count for less or more) and you can't take off. Try anyway and you lift a little, then your leashes snap taut and pull you back down; while they're that heavy, their leashes show it. Put their sigils down to fly again

changes.title: Legends flasks
items: A sleeping legend now dreams of a kind of animal, any age: bring one into its circle and it wakes happy and fights for you, and its island is found for tonight
An island found by a quest is kept on your sea chart only if you win the night; winning by itself finds no islands
Quests no longer give boons, and once the party's over legends take no more quests
Flasks are a growth spurt: stand on one's sigil and press E to drink it, and every animal following you grows into an adult at once

changes.title: Wave speed
items: The waves come slower: the pulse runs at 1 m/s to start
Set the wave speed on the pause page (Esc), from 0 (no waves) to 6 m/s; it's remembered
The bedroom's Waves dropdown is gone
